forms.join.metaDescription: Sign up for a seat on the grid: requirements, how it works and the sign-up form – no login, done in a few minutes.
forms.join.title: Join the grid
forms.join.lead: Fancy a seat on the grid? Here you will find what you need, how signing up works – and the form. No login required.
forms.join.status.title: Sign-up status
forms.join.status.waitlistText: All places are taken at the moment. Sign up anyway – you will go on the waiting list and we will get in touch as soon as a place opens up.
forms.join.status.closedText: We are not taking new sign-ups at the moment. Drop by on Discord – that is where we announce when they reopen.
forms.join.requirements.title: Requirements
forms.join.steps.title: How signing up works
forms.join.steps.1.title: Fill in the form
forms.join.steps.1.text: Gamertag, Discord name, platform and preferred number – that is all we need.
forms.join.steps.2.title: Join our Discord
forms.join.steps.2.text: All communication happens on our Discord server, from race-day check-in to questions from the stewards.
forms.join.steps.3.title: An admin gets in touch
forms.join.steps.3.text: We review your sign-up and message you on Discord.
forms.join.steps.4.title: Your role
forms.join.steps.4.text: You get a regular cockpit or a place in the reserve pool – depending on free places and your preferred role.
forms.join.gamertagHint: This is how you appear in results and standings. We automatically remove invisible characters and double spaces.
forms.join.eaIdHint: So the host can invite you to the lobby across platforms.
forms.join.discordHint: So we can reach you. Only visible to the admins, never published.
forms.join.numberHint: 2 to 99 – number 1 is reserved for the champion. You keep your number for as long as you race with us.
forms.join.number.invalid: Please enter a whole number from 2 to 99.
forms.join.number.error: The check is not working right now – we will check the number when you submit.
forms.join.nationalityHint: For the flag next to your name.
forms.join.role.any: Either – I just want to race
forms.join.availabilityHint: How often can you make it on race days?
forms.join.experienceHint: For example other leagues or seasons you have raced in. 1,000 characters at most.
forms.join.referenceTimeHint: Time trial lap with track, for example 1:29.812 (Suzuka).
forms.join.age16: I am at least 16 years old.
forms.join.rules.after: – including the publication of my gamertag and my results.
forms.join.privacy.after: explains how we handle your data. Only your gamertag, race number, platform and – if provided – your flag are public.
forms.join.success.title: Thanks, {name}! We have your sign-up.
forms.join.success.text: Your sign-up has been saved. An admin will review it and get in touch with you.
forms.join.success.waitlist: All places are taken at the moment – you are on the waiting list.
forms.join.success.step1: Join our Discord – that is where all communication happens.
forms.join.success.step2: An admin will message you on Discord, usually within a few days.
forms.join.success.step3: We will place you as a regular or reserve driver.
forms.join.success.step4: In the meantime, read the rules and have a look at the beginner's guide.
forms.join.success.noDiscord: The admin will send you the Discord invite link.
forms.contact.metaDescription: Write to league management: questions, partnership enquiries, data protection or feedback.
forms.contact.title: Contact
forms.contact.lead: Questions, partnership enquiries, data protection or feedback? Write to us – we will reply as soon as we can.
forms.contact.discordHint: For questions about race day or your sign-up, Discord is usually quicker.
forms.contact.emailText: You can also reach us directly by email:
forms.contact.imprintNote: Alongside the email address, this form is the second quick way of contacting us listed in the legal notice.

forms.contact.nameHint: What should we call you? A gamertag is fine.
forms.contact.subject: Subject

forms.contact.success.text: We have received it and will reply by email.
